title: RxSight (RXST) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut After Analysts Flag Execution Risks
summary: The average fair value estimate for RxSight has been cut from about US$7.57 to roughly US$6.10, a decline of around 19% that reflects a more cautious stance in current models. Recent analyst commentary links these lower price targets to execution risks, softer Q3 revenue of US$24.6m, and sector pressure in ophthalmology that is affecting confidence in earlier growth assumptions. As you read on, you will see how these shifting expectations are shaping the RxSight narrative and what to watch...
